text: The Haas partner brands have been split up since the deal was signed. RUCKUS Networks was sold by Vistance Networks (formerly CommScope Holding) to Belden Inc. (NYSE: BDC) on 1 July 2026, while the CommScope name and its connectivity business went to Amphenol Corporation in January 2026 for $10.5bn. Belden is a US-listed manufacturer with no state stake; ownership of the sponsor is therefore private, and human-rights relevance is ordinary manufacturing supply chain.
short: The Haas partner brands have been split up since the deal was signed.

source.name: Belden Inc. - 'Belden Completes Acquisition of RUCKUS Networks'
